tweets.content: Learning system design in theory is one thing, but how do you know if your design would really work? I'm building a sandbox where you can drag and drop components, run simulations, and get concrete feedback - like cost and failure rates. No more vague feedback. #SystemDesign

Ditched Playwright in my System Architect Sandbox project, simplifying the tech stack and reducing overhead. Now, users can focus on designing and simulating real software systems, getting concrete feedback on performance and cost. #SystemDesign
